item.title: Kylie Cantrall Embraces ‘New Chapter of My Life’ on ‘Valley Girl Problems’ EP: See the Release Date
item.description:
Here's a short and engaging podcast script based on the article:
[Upbeat music plays]
Host: "Hey there, music lovers! We've got some exciting news to share with you today. Disney star Kylie Cantrall is all set to release her brand new EP, Valley Girl Problems, on July 24th.
This eight-track EP marks a new chapter in Kylie's music career, as she transitions from acting to becoming a household name in pop music. The lead single, 'Carrie Bradshaw', was released back in April, and we can't wait to hear the rest of the tracks, including 'Grwm', 'Closet', and 'Girls Like U'.
Kylie worked with some big-name producers and songwriters on this project, including Tricky Stewart, who's worked with Rihanna and Tyla, and Tayla Parx, who's co-written hits for Ariana Grande and Panic! at the Disco.
In a statement, Kylie said, 'I've always heard people say, 'Write what you know,' and that's exactly what I did with this EP.' She's poured her heart and soul into Valley Girl Problems, and we can't wait to give it a listen.
Before the EP drops, you can catch Kylie in the Disney Channel sequel, Descendants: Wicked Wonderland, which premieres on July 16th. And if you're new to Kylie's music, be sure to check out her debut EP, B.O.Y., which was released last year.
That's all for today, folks! Mark your calendars for July 24th and get ready to dive into Valley Girl Problems. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you in the next one!"
[Music continues to play until the end]
